properties.title: Keep the Strait of Gibraltar open
properties.message: Gibraltar is under 50 km wide, about half a cell at 1 degree, but it is the Mediterranean's only exchange with the Atlantic. Closed, the Mediterranean grows far too salty.
properties.instruction: Edit the land mask and bathymetry to keep a channel open, and check the exchange and the salinity of the Mediterranean outflow.

references.title: Expert interview 1: Coral Triangle & Benguela Upwelling

evidence.quote: you cannot close it because it is the only exchange between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
